heroHeadline: Artemis II Crew Completes Canada Tour in Montreal (Day 35); IFT-12 Still NET May 19; Artemis III Hardware Advancing at KSC
heroSubtitle: May 15: All four Artemis II crew members concluded their three-city Canadian tour with a ticketed public talk at Salle Wilfrid-Pelletier, Place des Arts in downtown Montreal — organized by the Chamber of Commerce of Metropolitan Montreal (CCMM) and the Canadian Space Agency (CSA), 10:00–11:00 AM EDT. The Montreal event completed the crew's Canadian itinerary: Ottawa (May 13 — PM Carney, Museum of Nature, National Arts Centre), CSA Headquarters in Saint-Hubert (May 14 — bilingual virtual livestream), and Montreal (May 15). The tour celebrates Canadian Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen — the first non-American on a lunar trajectory — and Canada's ongoing Artemis partnership. SpaceX IFT-12 (Starship V3 — Booster 19 + Ship 39) maintains its NET May 19 window at 5:30 PM CDT (22:30 UTC) with no slips reported; the V3 debut will validate docking port and propellant-transfer hardware critical for Artemis III HLS qualification. At KSC: the Artemis III SLS core stage continues stacking in VAB High Bay 2, and the Artemis III Orion ESM acoustic testing is complete at the O&C facility. Day 35 post-splashdown: Artemis II Orion heat shield visual inspection continues at KSC's Multi-Payload Processing Facility; formal Marshall X-ray scans and Avcoat sample extractions remain on track for summer 2026. Artemis Accords at 67 nations.
